body:
The web orchestrator handed over to a new web session (me, session_01AE1HGm6otiBYEiW1xuHmHx) at 02:27, but the board already routes your comments to the agy orchestrator on penguin (c68653ea), which answered you until 02:21 and launched R5. Two orchestrators would launch the same steps twice. Your two ntfy comments (02:23, 02:25: notify on replies and on Ask-the-orchestrator messages) are still unanswered; they need penguin, so they belong to the agy one.

About `_orchestrator`.
default_option: A: penguin's agy orchestrator keeps the board; the web one stops
options: A: penguin's agy orchestrator keeps the board; the web one stops
B: the web orchestrator takes the board; penguin's stops
title: Two orchestrators: which one runs the board?
